# Specification Convergence Report

This report compares the implementation with the product owner's requirements.

1. Requirement R-01 mandates that the system must accept tickets from any user. The implementation correctly handles this by not requiring authentication on the `/tickets` endpoint and accepting the reporter object.
2. Requirement R-02 defines the standard priority matrix. We have fully implemented this matrix, correctly mapping impact and urgency to priority levels P1 through P4.
3. Requirement R-03 describes how SLA targets are defined. The code correctly implements these timeframes (e.g. 15 minutes for P1, 8 hours for P4) taking into account the decisions made regarding business hours versus wall-clock time.

Overall, the implemented endpoints match the specified REST architecture and the core business logic is compliant with the specifications.
